_comment: Curated French stopword set for IwacSearch. Loaded via PUT /stopwords/fr_default at module activation (or via the discovery:reindex CLI). Public scoped keys reference it as `stopwords: fr_default` so the public client cannot omit it.
_source: Standard French stopwords + IWAC-specific noise terms (e.g. 'après', 'avant'). Trimmed to high-impact tokens; over-aggressive lists harm recall.
_locale_note: Deliberately 'en', NOT 'fr': the v3 collections index with the default (en) pipeline so diacritics fold to ASCII (see the ACCENTS note in data/schema.yaml). The stopword set must tokenize the same way, or accented stopwords ('été', 'très', 'à') would no longer match the folded query stream.
